hero.title: Everyday essentials, delivered to your door

intro.lead: Your premier online grocery shop - supermarket quality, delivered in Colombo and suburbs.

welcome.body: elcome to Snappers, the premier online grocery shop that brings the supermarket to your doorstep. Our easy-to-use website allows you to shop from the comfort of your own home, with our vast selection of fresh produce, pantry staples, snacks, and more. We pride ourselves on our unbeatable prices and strive to offer our customers the best value possible. In addition, we offer exclusive discounts and offers to our loyal customers. With Snappers, you can enjoy the convenience of online shopping without sacrificing the quality of your groceries. Shop with us today and discover the Snappers difference for yourself.

items.title: Fast delivery
items.text: Colombo and suburbs only. Order before 2:00 PM for same-day delivery; after 2:00 PM, next-day delivery.

items.title: Supermarket quality
items.text: Fresh produce, pantry staples, and household essentials from brands you already trust.

items.title: Weekly deals
items.text: Exclusive offers and promotions so you can stock up and save on everyday shopping.

items.title: Shop your way
items.text: Browse by category, checkout securely online, and get updates until your order arrives.

closing.body: We're proud to serve Colombo and suburbs with grocery delivery that's fast, friendly, and built for everyday life. Thank you for choosing Snappers.
